items.title: Accuracy of Navigated Osteotomies in Rhinoplasty: A Cadaveric Analysis
items.fact_zh: 9具尸头18侧电磁导航截骨，实际截骨线与规划平均偏差1.5mm，经鼻与经皮入路无差异。
items.take_zh: 导航能把截骨做到亚毫米级，但尸头没出血没肿胀；真实价值在二次鼻和畸形鼻，不在常规截骨。
items.scene_zh: 病人问能不能截得更准，我说准不准靠设计和手感，导航是给复杂病例上保险。
items.fact_en: In nine cadaver heads, 18 electromagnetically navigated osteotomies deviated from the planned nasomaxillary suture by a mean of 1.5 mm, with transnasal and percutaneous routes equally accurate.
items.take_en: Sub-millimeter accuracy in a bloodless cadaver model proves feasibility, not superiority; navigation earns its cost in revision and distorted anatomy, not routine osteotomy.

items.title: Infraorbital versus sphenopalatine ganglion block for patient-reported recovery after septorhinoplasty: A randomized controlled trial
items.fact_zh: 90例鼻中隔鼻整形RCT：眶下神经阻滞24小时QoR-15为129.1分，蝶腭神经节阻滞116.6分。
items.take_zh: 眶下阻滞疼痛和恢复质量全面胜出，补救镇痛11%对53%；鼻整形术后镇痛该换默认选项。
items.scene_zh: 术后疼不疼，很大程度取决于麻醉打的是哪一针，这事术前就该跟病人说清楚。
items.fact_en: In a 90-patient RCT, ultrasound-guided infraorbital block beat transnasal sphenopalatine ganglion block on 24-hour QoR-15 (129.1 vs 116.6), with rescue analgesia in 11.4% versus 53.3%.
items.take_en: The margin exceeds the minimal clinically important difference and cuts rescue opioid use fivefold; infraorbital block deserves to become the default for septorhinoplasty.

items.title: The V-Shaped Subdomal Graft: A Structural Template for Geometric Control of the Nasal Tip
items.fact_zh: PRS提出V形鼻小柱下移植物，用几何模板同时控制鼻尖宽度、高度与旋转。
items.take_zh: 把鼻尖控制做成模板，说明手感难复制；思路值得学，但一块移植物解决不了所有鼻尖。
items.scene_zh: 鼻尖不够翘又怕做太高，这种病人我先看鼻中隔支撑够不够，而不是先加块移植物。
items.fact_en: A PRS technique paper introduces a V-shaped subdomal graft as a geometric template for controlling tip width, height and rotation together.
items.take_en: Template-driven tip surgery is valuable as a teaching scaffold, but it cannot replace diagnosing the underlying support deficit case by case.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Facelift Surgery: A Systematic Review of Objective Outcome Assessment and Patient-Perceived Rejuvenation
items.fact_zh: 9项研究的系统综述：AI测得减龄1.7–5.8岁，比患者自感年轻程度低35%–50%。
items.take_zh: 机器算出的岁数不能当疗效指标，患者照镜子那一眼才是；AI目前只能做辅助记录。
items.scene_zh: 病人拿手机测脸龄给我看，我会说那玩意儿只认皱纹，不认松弛。
items.fact_en: Across nine studies, AI age estimation after facelift showed 1.7 to 5.8 years of reduction but underestimated patient-perceived rejuvenation by 35% to 50%.
items.take_en: Systematic discordance with patient perception means AI-derived age is a research metric, not an outcome measure to quote in clinic.

items.title: Clinical Outcomes of Submuscular vs Subglandular Implant Placement in Primary Cosmetic Breast Augmentation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.fact_zh: 12项研究4534例：肌下/双平面总体并发症OR 0.49，包膜挛缩OR 0.58，血肿OR 0.30。
items.take_zh: 肌下赢在并发症，满意度和再手术率却没差别；腺体覆盖够的瘦病人，不必一刀切放肌下。
items.scene_zh: 病人问放肌肉下还是腺体下，我说先看你皮够不够厚、腺体盖不盖得住假体边缘。
items.fact_en: Pooling 12 studies and 4,534 patients, submuscular or dual-plane placement had lower odds of overall complications (OR 0.49), contracture (OR 0.58) and hematoma (OR 0.30), with no difference in satisfaction or reoperation.
items.take_en: Lower complication odds are real, but unchanged satisfaction and reoperation mean implant plane should follow tissue coverage, not habit.

items.title: Association of Ultrasound-Guided PECS II Block with Postoperative Pain Scores and Recovery Outcomes in Subpectoral Breast Augmentation: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.fact_zh: 48例胸肌下隆胸回顾：加PECS II阻滞后PACU疼痛评分1分对4分，无人需补救哌替啶。
items.take_zh: 样本小、回顾性，但差距大得不像偶然；把PECS II写进常规镇痛，成本低收益明确。
items.scene_zh: 怕疼的病人，我会提前说麻醉能在胸壁加一针阻滞，术后第一晚差别很明显。
items.fact_en: In 48 subpectoral augmentations, adding a PECS II block cut PACU pain scores (median 1 vs 4) and eliminated protocol-driven rescue meperidine (0% vs 71.4%).
items.take_en: Retrospective and small, but the effect size is too large to dismiss; PECS II is a cheap addition to standard multimodal analgesia.
